summary: BR Brain critical optimization batch: native-first ranking, context reuse and swipe recall

changes.title: Native-first experimental hybrid ranking
changes.detail: Keep automatic correction and protected suggestions native; permit only one adjacent near-tied manual candidate swap with known vocabulary, decisive neural evidence, and an 8 ms result-acceptance budget. ContextLM remains opt-in and unapproved.

changes.title: Reuse unchanged context
changes.detail: Memoize exact token-context encoding within the eligible editor/model scope, detach on privacy, editor, cursor and IME lifecycle boundaries, preserve scorer math and avoid per-candidate feature arrays.

changes.title: Bounded swipe recall
changes.detail: Try one nearby ambiguous endpoint, lazily verify lexical alternatives in original primary order within the previous 28-word budget, retain native top result and avoid native decoder reentry.

changes.title: Regression tests
changes.detail: Add hybrid guardrail, exact-context parity and bounded recall tests. No new models, dependencies, permissions or signer changes.
